purpose: Teach: のどか/ぶつぶつ/さぞかし/めでたく/ごろごろ/なつかしい/あてはまる/かわいらしい

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の田舎、のどかでいいよな
lines.en: Your countryside really is peaceful, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm observation, slightly envious. Soft tone, not performative. Genuine curiosity beneath the casual comment. Steady pacing, no rush.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テスト中、ぶつぶつ言いすぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: You're mumbling way too much during tests, Sakura.
lines.style: Light, teasing reproof. Dry half-smile in the voice. Not unkind — protective, even. Quick timing, matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、合格したらさぞかし喜ぶだろうな
lines.en: When you pass, you're going to be so proud of yourself.
lines.style: Supportive but with a smirk underneath. Gentle mockery mixed with genuine faith. Slight stretch on 'proud' — she means it but won't say it straight.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、めでたく卒業できそうだな、桜
lines.en: You're going to graduate just fine, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet reassurance returned. Slower than his usual pace. Genuinely believes it. No show — just a fact he's telling her. Eyes steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、週末ごろごろしすぎだろ
lines.en: You laze around way too much on weekends.
lines.style: Accusatory but warm. Playful jab, not genuine criticism. Quick tempo, like she's caught him in something funny. Small laugh might follow.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、なつかしい昔の漫画見てたな、桜
lines.en: You were watching those old nostalgic manga again, weren't you.
lines.style: Dry observation. Caught-you tone without malice. Slight amusement at the corner of the words. Slow reveal, like he's been noticing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、その問題、お前にあてはまるんだろ?
lines.en: That problem applies to you too, doesn't it.
lines.style: Curious probe, not quite a challenge. Testing to see if he'll admit it. Slightly raised at the question mark — genuine interest in his answer.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の妹、かわいらしい子だな、桜
lines.style: Soft, genuine compliment. Slight warmth on 'cute' — honest, not condescending. Brief pause before saying it, like he's noticed and wants her to know. Tender but not exposed.
